versions.content: Upon receiving a SPATEM, the TLM service makes the content of the SPATEM available to the V2X Applications. Received SPATEMs shall be sent to the application layer via their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xApplRxIndicationSpatem . For details see [20] chapter 5 .
